meta.title: About me — Christine CAL
meta.description: Christine CAL's journey: a chartered accountant who became a clairvoyant and clairaudient medium, awakening coach, speaker and creator of an initiatory teaching.

hero.title: An atypical free spirit in contact with her future selves

epigraph: She lives in several worlds at once, and has the rare gift of connecting them: the sky and everyday life, the invisible and the concrete. Feet on the Earth, eyes on the stars, a warmth that welcomes, a demand for truth that awakens. A galactic soul from the future, deeply human, who takes you by the hand to show you the light you already carry.

galactic.heading: A galactic soul from a future
items: Having left her faraway land to take part in the emancipation of this magnificent planet Earth, in this recently liberated galaxy.
Having reconnected with her multidimensional identity by consciously reintegrating her Earthly fractals at the close of this Apocalyptic cycle.
Working with her Celestial fractals across the different timelines.
